title: lycopodium flabelliforme f. foliaceum
intro: Lycopodium flabelliforme f. foliaceum, commonly known as a variant of the Lycopodium flabelliforme species, is a plant that belongs to the family Lycopodiaceae. It is a type of club moss, a small, herbaceous perennial plant that grows in shaded areas. The health benefits of Lycopodium flabelliforme f. foliaceum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate the immune system and its potential as a natural antiseptic, while its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids.
